title: Optimal Fusion Strategies for Quantum Computation
summary: Logical fusions are important for a number of tasks in quantum information, such as quantum error correction and quantum repeaters. In the photonic setting one must contend with the fact that physical fusions can fail, i.e. individual qubits are measured in a user-controlled product state basis with some probability, which can lead to a failure on the logical level. The choice of failure basis of each qubit is known as a fusion strategy, and finding good fusion strategies is important for optimizing performance of fusion-based quantum computation.
